<h1>TX Racial Profiling Data</h1>

<p>
The purpose of this tool is to make racial profiling data easier to enter, check, and analyze in the state of Texas. It is designed for Texas law enforcement agencies to support the review and analysis of their racial profiling data and to assist agencies with the comparative analysis required under Texas Code of Criminal Procedure, Article 2B.0053. This tool is currently in beta testing. We are asking testers to look for errors, unexpected results, confusing wording, or anything that could be improved or added. <strong>Data entered into the application is not stored or retained.</strong> If you want to keep your work, use the Download button in the application to save a copy to your computer. Please send an <a href="mailto:mduran29@asu.edu">email</a> to Matthew Durán with any ideas to make this more useful for your agency. Thank you!
</p>

</div>
